segments.text: A girl trained as a Ranger, the most agile of all classes of Knight. She lives in constant starvation in the Republic of Lancelot, and is something like a stray kitten.
She was Bolonious's favorite student. She was an orphan trained at Ranger Academy and sold off by the Academy to Rochefort as her new master.
From Mangagamer
騎士の中でも素早さを信条とするレンジャー技術を習得している少女。
ランスロット共和国で野良にゃんにゃんのような野宿生活を送りいつもお腹を減らしている。
将骑士中被认为最高敏捷型的“游侠（レンジャー）技术”习得的少女。在兰斯洛特（ランスロット）共和国里像野猫一样过着流浪生活，总是肚子空空的状态。
「唔，为了能让大家露出笑容，把坏人们都干掉吧。毕竟，那就是骑士的任务嘛」
One of Asterisk's sisters, and Kyou's twin sister, who looked after Asterisk.
They taught Asterisk everything about fighting monsters and living life to the fullest, as well as having encouraged him to travel to the mainland.
A dragon, and member of the Witches of the Round Table. During the Arthur Tragedy, Asterisk's parents entrusted Asterisk to the twins.
姉としてアスタリスクを育てた双子の姉妹。
モンスターと戦う技術や生活する術を教え、大陸への旅立ちを後押しした。
作为姐姐抚养阿斯塔的双子姐妹。教会了阿斯塔与怪物战斗的技术与生活技巧，为他在大陆的旅行提供着后援。
「通过正当途径来迎娶众多媳妇的阿斯塔，才是值得我们二人献出纯洁的人呢」

モンスターと戦う技術や生活する術を教え、大陸への旅立ちを後押しした。
作为姐姐抚养阿斯塔的双子姐妹。教会了阿斯塔与怪物战斗的技术与生活技巧，为他在大陆的旅行提供着后援。
「那么，为了能娶回众多可爱的女孩子，努力再努力地奋斗吧」

A man from the barely-populated Fresh Fish Island, he was raised by a pair of beautiful twins named Kinou and Kyou . Seeking to have sex with both of the sisters by becoming a Knight, he decides to go on a journey. His primary goal, and one that the sisters encourage, is to become a great enough man to marry lots of women.
He is the prince of Kingdom of Arthur, and is a half-dragon. His father Tram was a human, while his mother Ruto was a dragon and a member of the Witch of the Round Table.
From Mangagamer
魚鮮島という過疎の島で双子の美人姉妹に育てられた青年。
双子の姉妹とエッチするために騎士となるべく旅に出る。
双子姉妹の後押しも有り、お嫁さんをたくさんもらえる立派な男になるのが当面の目的である。
魔法剑士，在人烟稀少的小岛上长大，对异性有超出常人的兴趣。
The second princess of the Kingdom of Eden.

She’s pursuing Snake Crest, an evil organization plotting to put the world at war, all by herself. At the same time, she’s searching for a personal Knight she can trust to assist her. Childhood friends with Ramius.
From Mangagamer

She has a legendary mother and a talented brother who she struggles to live up to, but continually fails to do so. Even her fellow Knights keep their distance from her, but she’s still striving to improve for the sake of defending her nation. Riche's childhood friend.

segments.text: A young Zero Knight with the rare ability to enhance the capabilities of others. She is also a talented tactician. One of the three Zero Knights of Kingdom of Eden, but she is a Zero Knight under the Kingdom of Eden only by name. Because of special circumstances and her major contributions to the Arthur Tragedy, she was promoted to Zero Knight at a young age.
Currently recluse from society undertaking peculiar kinds of research while relying on the Amuzon delivery service to sustain herself.
From Mangagamer
A half-poppin from the Kingdom of Humpty. Because she is half-blooded, she is discriminated by most from both races.
A Zero Knight of the Central Empire.
Currently Prince Felton's bodyguard.
A dragon. Although she is Felton's accomplice to further his plans, she is not a member of Snake Crest.
Eldest daughter of the March family, a prestigious family in Kingdom of Humpty.
She is a Thousand Knight currently serving the Kingdom of Humpty.
Joins as a member of Snake Crest.
She is a candidate for the president of the Republic of Lancelot.

She is the caretaker for the girls secretly taken in by the Kingdom of Eden that became outlaws from unfortunate circumstances. She took up the responsibility upon herself because of how her deceased little sister was raped which resulted in her becoming an outlaw. Her little sister was irrationally robbed of her normal life because of it.
A girl who travels from country to country and reads her hand-drawn storybooks to children focused on the history and achievements of Arthur.

She is the daughter of a senator in Hamlet. She is traveling around the continent to collect money to help the hospitalized kids back in Hamlet, and to share her personal experiences of the outside world to those kids. She was sickly at a young age, so she spent a lot of time in the hospital.
The first princess of the Kingdom of Eden and Riche's elder sister. She is also a Saint of the Church of Mother Eve.
She is betrothed to Felton, the prince of Central Empire.
Currently resides with QD.
Head of the Witches of the Round Table
A Saint of the Church of Mother Eve.
A Saint of the Church of Mother Eve.
The Head Saint of the Church of Mother Eve.
As a half-dragon, she can use teleportation magic to move between Churches of Mother Eve.

The official mascot of Alice Soft. A polite young girl who often communicates with the player as a medium in some Alice Soft games. She sometimes represent marketing upcoming Alice Soft games in trailers and advertisements.
She is accompanied by her pet black crow named Yukichi.

segments.text: One of the three Zero Knights of the Kingdom of Eden
Ramius's older brother.

An important figure in Snake Crest. In the middle of a fierce battle during the Arthur Tragedy he killed his mother. Possessed by madness, Ramius and Acheval's mother was the one who started the Arthur Tragedy, killing many Zero Knights who tried to destroy Snake Crest amidst the chaos. Distraught that Ramius might end up on the same path as their mother, he tried to push Ramius away from the path of a knight.
Unbeknownst to even himself, he is the Black Knight, but Millet uses her power to suppress his memory of this while he lives his normal life.
One of the three Zero Knights of the Kingdom of Eden
General of El Quixote's Knights. He is in a relationship with Lorenzo.
Ex-Hundred Knight and current Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Eden.
Master of Gurigura. Member of Snake Crest.
CEO of Bigbux Company in El Quixote. A powerful figure in the business world.

She is of the Kalar race and Queen Mertel's personal secretary. She is in a relationship with Pancho.
Queen of Kingdom of Humpty, the current ruler after her husband fell ill. Since the King cannot handle his public duties anymore, she has taken over his place.
The prince of Central Empire. Betrothed to Croix Eden.
An important figure in Snake Crest. He is the White Knight.
The best chef in Kingdom of Humpty.
An important figure in Snake Crest. He was malnourished as a child and ate his mother.

He is a famous doctor in Hamlet. He has retired as a knight, but he is well-known as the strongest Zero Knight. People called him names such as 'The Strongest Knight, Ultimate Knight, Ultimate Ranger, Legendary Ranger'.
He was the principle of Ranger Academy.
An important figure in Snake Crest.
He is the father of Ophelia.

She was in love with her father, and wanted to forever bring those forbidden feelings with her to her death from her father Bolonious when she died of an incurable illness.
Her dead body was used and awakened to insanity as a powerful zombie by Snake Crest to further their plans.
Supreme Commander of Snake Crest.
He was the previous Pope of Church of Mother Eve. The father of the current Pope, Norshin. He caused the Arthur Tragedy.
A girl who runs a farm in the city of Abel in the Kingdom of Eden
A ghost that appear in the fog labyrinth in Eden.

She is Sora's sister, and the latter has used her appearance to deceive her customers at the Level Shop into thinking she is more voluptuous than she actually is. Mifa is a professional gadabout, with no inclination or ability to work for a living.
